question: Which customer has the highest average monthly change in payment amounts? Provide the customer's full name.
sql:
-- Full query: get the customer with highest average monthly change in payment amounts
WITH monthly_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', payment_date) as month,
    SUM(amount) as monthly_total
  FROM payment
  GROUP BY customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', payment_date)
),
with_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    month,
    monthly_total,
    monthly_total - LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) as change
  FROM monthly_totals
)
SELECT 
  c.first_name,
  c.last_name,
  AVG(wc.change) as avg_monthly_change,
  COUNT(wc.change) as num_changes
FROM with_changes wc
JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = wc.customer_id
WHERE wc.change IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.first_name, c.last_name
ORDER BY avg_monthly_change DESC
LIMIT 1
